title: Price shock
what: "WHY PAY $40,000 / $50,000 / OR EVEN $60,000?" stacks in red, gets struck through and falls away; the real price slams in gold.
use: Centre frame over B-roll on the price-anchor line. Swap the numbers in spec.json for the client's script.

title: Price card
what: Navy card: kicker, "starting at", price counts up and lands with a gold underline.
use: Lower-middle on the line where the VO says the price. Sits above the Reels caption zone.

title: Unit calculator
what: Rate lands, the quantity counts up while a tile grid fills, the total lands in gold. Set up as $125 per cabinet opening.
use: For per-unit offers (per opening, per sq ft, per window).

title: What's included
what: Card with title and gold price; inclusions arrive one per beat, each with a drawn icon, each ticks.
use: Under the VO listing what the package includes. 18 built-in icons.

title: Material price table
what: Countertop prices with drawn stone swatches: granite, quartz, marble.
use: Over countertop footage, one row per VO beat.

title: Tier ladder
what: Two packages stacked as a ladder: wet-area from $9,995, full remodel from $14,995.

title: Before/after wipe UI
what: Divider with a handle sweeps in, BEFORE / AFTER pills, optional badge. Includes a matte file that follows the divider.
use: Before clip under the left half, after clip on the right; use the matte as a track matte on the after clip.

title: Before/after stacked label
what: Horizontal split line with BEFORE above and AFTER below.

title: Spots left
what: Houses get stamped TAKEN, "3 SPOTS LEFT" lands in gold, qualifier boxes tick.
use: Scarcity beat. Numbers must be the client's real ones.

title: Get Quote end card
what: Phone rises, its Get Quote button is tapped, "TAP GET QUOTE BELOW", offer pill, big gold arrow.

title: Service area map
what: Abstract map draws on, area traced, pin drops, radius pulses, county label.
use: The service-area line. Change the label per client.

title: Trust seal: years
what: Seal counts up to the years in business, "IN BUSINESS SINCE".
use: Upper third on the credibility line. Client-confirmed numbers only.

title: Trust seal: licensed
what: Shield seal, "LICENSED & INSURED".
use: Upper third. Only for clients who are.

title: Trust seal: warranty
what: Ribboned seal with the warranty length.

title: Trust seal: in-house crew
what: Crew seal, "IN-HOUSE CREW / NO SUBCONTRACTORS".

title: Financing line
what: "$0 DOWN / OPTIONS AVAILABLE" pill; disclosure line only when supplied.
use: The compliant financing mention. Not for LHR, Midwest, Vistaguard or GC.

title: Hook: highlight
what: Words land one by one, a gold marker swipes behind the price.

title: Hook: stack
what: Full-width lines slam in, alternating white and gold.
use: First 2 seconds, or any punchy list ("No mess. No delays. No hidden costs.").

title: Hook: typewriter
what: Typewriter with a gold cursor, last word punches up.

title: Location super
what: Navy tab slides in with a pin: "SUFFOLK COUNTY / HOMEOWNERS".
use: Top third when the VO calls out the area.

title: Callout
what: Pulsing dot, a leader line draws out to a label.
use: Move the layer so the dot sits on the feature.

title: Annotate: circle
what: Sketchy gold loop.

title: Annotate: arrow
what: Curved gold arrow drawn in.

title: Annotate: X
what: Red X over a "before" problem.

title: Offer stamp
what: Gold-ink rubber stamp drops, squashes and rings out.
use: On the offer line. Copy must be the client's real offer.

title: Deadline calendar
what: Calendar flips to the end date, gold marker circles it.

title: Days-left countdown
what: Calendar flips 8-7-6 to "5 DAYS LEFT".

title: Us vs them
what: "Big showroom company" vs "Us"; each row gets X on theirs and a tick on ours.
use: Comparison beats. Rows must be true for the client.

title: Process steps
what: Five steps build down the screen with icons; finished steps tick.
use: The "how it works" section, one step per VO beat.

title: Stat counter
what: Odometer roll-up to a number with a label.

title: Badge row
what: Three navy badges with gold ticks pop in across the top.
use: Over B-roll while the VO lists perks.

title: Name lower third
what: Gold bar, navy card wipes out with name and title.

title: Day timeline
what: Day 1 to Day 7 bar fills, ends gold on "Done".

title: Transition: whip
what: Light streaks and a white band sweep across. 0.6s.

title: Transition: brand wipe
what: Diagonal navy panel with a gold trail. 0.8s.

title: Transition: flash
what: Warm white flash with bloom. 0.6s.

title: Transition: iris
what: Navy field closes through a gold-rimmed square, then opens. 0.8s.

title: Tap pointer
what: Drawn hand taps twice under "TAP GET QUOTE".
use: Over the CTA. Check the tap point against the real button placement.

title: Do you qualify?
what: Three questions tick YES, then "YOU QUALIFY / TAP GET QUOTE".

title: Tub to shower
what: Bathroom cutaway: tub lifts out, walls and glass go in, clock runs 8 AM to 5 PM.
use: Walk-in shower offers with no install footage. "In a day" must be client-confirmed.

title: Kitchen build
what: Plan lines, then cabinets, quartz, backsplash and pendants build in.

title: Bathroom build
what: Demo to studs, plumbing, tile, vanity, floor and lights, with six labels.

title: No middleman
what: Price chain stacks markups to $21,000, collapses to Manufacturer > Us > You.

title: Process road
what: A van drives a road through five stations; camera pulls back.

title: See it first
what: The kitchen draws itself in line art, then fills with colour.

title: Garage floor layers
what: Slab cutaway: grind, base coat, flake, topcoat.

title: Roof layers
what: Roof cutaway from rafters to ridge cap, each layer labelled.

title: One team
what: Split screen: three trades clash vs one crew finishing.

title: Leads leak
what: Leads spill out of four holes; Syrus patches each; slots book gold.

title: Speed to lead
what: New lead, stopwatch races, "Syrus calls in under 5 minutes", slot books.

title: Elite Craft before/after
what: Northport master bath: the before photo holds, a divider reveals the after.

title: Elite Craft feature callouts
what: Slow push on a finished shower; frameless glass, bench and LED mirror get labels.

title: Elite Craft blueprint reveal
what: The finished vanity appears as blueprint line art, then the real photo sweeps in.

title: Elite Craft project gallery
what: Five finished bathrooms fly in as cards; the last opens to full frame.

title: Elite Craft detail loupe
what: A loupe glides onto the hand-set mosaic niche and magnifies it.

title: Elite Craft demo to done
what: One shower: demo, tile, done, on a progress bar.

title: Work Horse barn before/after
what: Brown barn to red with black trim, same angle.

title: Work Horse cabin before/after
what: Weathered cabin to new dark stain, same angle.

title: Pay per shown appointment
what: Animated explainer for Syrus's pay-per-shown-appointment model.

title: Pay per estimate
what: Animated explainer for Syrus's pay-per-estimate model.
